implementation: Implement the handoff in canonical HTML, CSS and Vanilla JS; synchronize deploy and deploy/public, then assemble the actual production payload in deploy_personal_v3420.
Replace the directory-style home with an editorial bento grid, 20–24px corners, subtle glass and three-layer shadows; provide Obsidian Titanium and Porcelain Light themes.

Preserve existing offer records and CTA distinctions; map real codes to copy, in-store offers to terms, app offers to official app/campaign links.

Implement 90-day-low badge and affiliate attribution support, populating badges only from measured comparable price history and provider-confirmed affiliate links. Source and verify real product URLs and current prices for all 30 products; a count of rendered cards is insufficient.

commercial_accuracy.ninety_day_low_requires: At least 90 days of comparable SKU/variant/merchant price observations, coverage and timestamps; no invented history or badge.
commercial_accuracy.when_history_missing: Show dated observed price without a 90-day-low badge.
commercial_accuracy.when_affiliate_unconfirmed: Use a verified direct product URL and keep the current reference-catalog wording. Continue UI rollout independently.
commercial_accuracy.when_product_unverified: Acquire a real replacement in the same category; do not invent item IDs, store identity or prices.
commercial_accuracy.when_affiliate_confirmed: Enable provider-issued links and restore a clear commission disclosure for those links. Do not claim earned revenue without a provider report.
